findings.claim: The declared objective is final predicted target affinity as primary, with validity and strain secondary and coordinate control only; the reward view is the endpoint pointcloud with a detached FLOWR endpoint VJP, so any coordinate contrast is a reward-shaping signal rather than a physical interaction energy.

The observed learning window is the score-time grid 0.00-0.49 with curve support 0.0-0.49, and recorded affinities were removed with an equal score prior, so no absolute affinity target is observable in the supplied evidence.

Continuous contrast functions over the complete observed support are non-monotone: landmark_00_soft_mass shows 4 sign changes with first_rate_z +9.27 and last_rate_z -10.00, and landmark_00_local_dy shows 6 sign changes with first_rate_z -72.37 and last_rate_z +5.52, so a constant rule is not supported and a time-conditioned rule is indicated.

Fit fidelity is weak for several features (relative_node_RMSE 0.29-0.78) and polynomial fits are not accepted, so the observed-node linear interpolation is the only validated representation and extrapolation is disallowed.
Strong sign conflicts are present across features (up to 9 for landmark_00_local_dx), indicating that marginal rate estimates are unstable and should not be ranked on point estimates alone.

hypotheses.direction: time-conditioned sign flip within the observed window
hypotheses.falsifier: No sign change in the observed-node contrast, or relative_node_RMSE not improved over the constant rule.
hypotheses.observable: landmark_00_soft_mass contrast value at observed score nodes
hypotheses.scope: observed score window 0.0-0.49 only; no extrapolation
hypotheses.statement: A time-conditioned coordinate contrast that follows the observed-node sign of landmark_00_soft_mass (positive early, negative late) better expresses the observed support than a constant contrast rule.

hypotheses.falsifier: A feature with zero sign changes and no strong sign conflicts over the full window.
hypotheses.statement: Marginal landmark rate estimates are too unstable (multiple sign changes and strong sign conflicts) to support a single-feature coordinate intervention without multiplicity-adjusted support.

limitations: No decoded terminal labels or final affinity outcomes are supplied, so last-record or survival credit cannot be presented as final affinity benefit.
Only continuous_trends rows were read; branch_adjusted, survival_effects, increment_effects, turnover_accounting, joint_diagnostics and regional_effects were not inspected in this turn.
Contrast curves are reward-shaping diagnostics, not absolute reward targets or physical interaction energies.
No temperature edit is proposed; temperatures are immutable task parameters.
